Design-level gap found and patched: FormalizationGapPlannerRuntimeSubsystem.run was building runtime handoffs without consuming the task's runtime_learning_memory, so a resumed/manual FormalizationGapPlanner task could lose prior route-planner contract feedback even though the top-level runtime handoff builder already supported it. The subsystem now reads task-level runtime_learning_memory and architect_context.runtime_learning_memory rows, passes them into _runtime_formalization_gap_planner_handoff_rows, and records runtime_learning_rows plus route_contract_feedback_rows counts in the execution manifest. Regression test test_formalization_gap_planner_runtime_subsystem_replays_route_contract_feedback_from_memory exercises the full subsystem run path and confirms the handoff-local route_contract_feedback.jsonl, prompt CLI, live CLI, and execution-plan required_inputs all receive the prior contract feedback as non-proof planner memory.

Follow-up gap found and patched: AgentRuntime immediately executes result.next_task inside the same run, but FormalizationGapPlannerRuntimeSubsystem's bounded live-route follow-up task only carried top-level environment_feedback and did not self-contain the architect runtime_learning_memory that had just been used to build the handoff. The live follow-up task now carries a merged architect_context.runtime_learning_memory plus mirrored environment_feedback, so same-run live invocation, manual execution, and resumed execution all consume the same route-contract feedback path instead of relying on end-of-run pending-task repair. Regression test test_formalization_gap_planner_runtime_subsystem_requests_live_followup_when_enabled now seeds route-planner contract feedback memory and confirms the next task preserves the feedback row, handoff boundary, selected_handoff_ids, and route_contract_feedback row counts as non-proof planner memory.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_revision_overlay_runtim: Design-level gap found and patched: live target-prover replay already emitted route_revision_proposals, learning rows, agenda rows, and generated next-action routing, but did not materialize the existing formalization-gap-planner route-revision overlay artifact. The runtime now reuses export_formalization_gap_planner_route_revision_overlay after refinement evidence, records overlay dir/manifest/counts in live rows and execution contexts, propagates those fields through target-prover replay learning rows, agenda rows, generated routing, Formalizer proof-bank memory summaries, and audit payloads, and tightens the capability scorecard so route-revision proposals require planner-consumable overlay evidence before the live-route followthrough gate passes. Regression coverage: live follow-up target-prover replay, live-route summary counts, scorecard followthrough, and runtime audit recomputation.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_revision_overlay_route_: Follow-up design gap found and patched: after target-prover replay materialized formalization-gap-planner route-revision overlays, the next FormalizationGapPlanner handoff still did not feed those overlay dirs into the existing LLM route-planner overlay input channel unless a caller supplied them manually. Runtime handoff generation now selects matching overlay learning rows by bridge id, target ids, or seed path; records overlay dir/manifest/counts on the handoff and execution context; adds the overlay dir to staged/live route-planner required_inputs; passes --formalization-gap-planner-route-revision-overlay-dir through both prompt and live CLIs; and supplies formalization_gap_planner_route_revision_overlay_dir to live route-planner execution. This is non-proof planner memory: it revises the next route-planning prompt but does not promote theorem evidence.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_revision_overlay_cli_me: Follow-up design gap found and patched: CLI/runtime resume memory could keep only latest rows and compact away a bare formalization_gap_planner_target_prover_replay_feedback row's route-revision overlay fields when the row lacked input_summary.trigger. The runtime and CLI route-memory classifiers now treat typed live route-planner contract feedback and target-prover replay feedback learning tasks as formal-gap routing memory even in compact/bare form, and CLI memory compaction preserves route_revision_proposal_id, route ids, revised primitives, overlay dirs/manifests/counts, prover diagnostic status, and replay artifact paths. Regression test test_runtime_learning_memory_pins_bare_target_prover_route_revision_overlay confirms a max_rows=1 resume memory keeps the older replay overlay row over later filler rows and exposes its overlay manifest/counts through Formalizer proof-bank formal_gap_next_action_contract as non-proof planner memory.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_memory_protocol_shared_: Design drift guard added: the formal-gap route-memory protocol no longer has independently handwritten route id, trigger, and feedback learning-task sets in CLI resume-memory and AgentRuntime proof-bank memory. research_agent_runtime.py now exposes RUNTIME_FORMAL_GAP_NEXT_ACTION_ROUTE_IDS, RUNTIME_FORMAL_GAP_NEXT_ACTION_TRIGGERS, and RUNTIME_FORMAL_GAP_ROUTE_FEEDBACK_LEARNING_TASKS; CLI resume-memory references those constants; and test_cli_and_runtime_formal_gap_route_memory_classifiers_stay_aligned asserts compact/bare route-planner contract feedback, target-prover replay feedback, gap-planner handoff rows, and generic filler rows receive identical route/stage classification in both paths. This prevents future feedback artifacts from being preserved in one entrypoint but silently dropped in the other.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_memory_protocol_audit_s: Follow-up design drift guard added: runtime and CLI were sharing formal-gap route-memory protocol constants, but research_agent_runtime_audit.py still hand-classified generated routing tasks, target-prover replay feedback tasks, and formal-gap handoff agenda/trigger values. research_agent_runtime.py now exposes generated-routing, direct-feedback, live route-planner contract-feedback, and target-prover replay-feedback task sets; runtime, CLI, and audit reference those sets; audit target-prover replay route-revision learning/generated-row classifiers no longer maintain independent task literals; and test_cli_and_runtime_formal_gap_route_memory_classifiers_stay_aligned now asserts CLI/runtime/audit protocol identity plus the audit distinction between bare target-prover replay feedback and generated target-prover route-revision routing rows.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_revision_overlay_enviro: Follow-up design gap found and patched: FormalizationGapPlannerRuntimeSubsystem consumed route-revision overlays from task.runtime_learning_memory and architect_context.runtime_learning_memory, but direct task-level environment_feedback only preserved live route-planner contract feedback. A manual/same-run FormalizationGapPlanner task handed direct formalization_gap_planner_target_prover_replay_feedback would therefore drop the route-revision overlay before handoff generation. _runtime_formalization_gap_planner_task_runtime_learning_rows now routes environment_feedback through the shared formal-gap route-memory classifier while preserving the legacy route_planner_contract_feedback_id path, so target-prover replay route-revision overlay feedback reaches the next planner handoff as non-proof planner memory. Regression test test_formalization_gap_planner_runtime_subsystem_replays_route_revision_overlay_from_environment_feedback confirms the execution manifest and handoff carry route_revision_overlay_dir/manifest/counts and prompt/live required_inputs without requiring architect_context runtime memory.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_revision_overlay_high_p: Follow-up design gap found and patched: pending/same-run continuations can carry target-prover replay route-revision agenda rows in environment_feedback.high_priority_agenda, and audit already counts those rows as target-prover route-revision feedback, but FormalizationGapPlanner handoff generation only consumed task/architect runtime-learning rows plus direct environment_feedback. High-priority agenda rows carrying route_revision_overlay_dir/manifest or route_planner_contract_feedback_id now enter the same handoff-memory ingress, so planner handoffs consume pending agenda feedback rather than merely reporting it in audit. Regression test test_formalization_gap_planner_runtime_subsystem_replays_route_revision_overlay_from_high_priority_agenda confirms an agenda-only target-prover route-revision overlay reaches route_revision_overlay_dir/manifest and prompt/live required_inputs as non-proof planner memory.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_contract_feedback_input: Follow-up selector gap found and patched: FormalizationGapPlanner task ingress could now accept compact/direct formal-gap environment_feedback rows whose learning_task and route_planner_contract_feedback_id lived under input_summary, but _runtime_formalization_gap_planner_route_contract_feedback_rows_for_bridge still matched only top-level learning_task, feedback id, bridge ids, target ids, and seed paths. The route-contract feedback selector now mirrors the route-revision overlay selector by reading the row plus input_summary via _runtime_learning_row_string_values, so compact/nested route-planner contract feedback reaches handoff-local route_contract_feedback.jsonl, prompt CLI, live CLI, and execution-plan required_inputs. Regression test test_formalization_gap_planner_runtime_subsystem_replays_nested_route_contract_feedback_from_environment_feedback covers the direct environment_feedback compact shape.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_route_feedback_input_summary_: Follow-up agenda gap found and patched: compact formal-gap feedback rows could be retained in runtime memory and consumed by handoff selectors, but the high-priority agenda appenders for live route-planner contract repair and target-prover replay route revision still checked only top-level learning_task. They also masked nested contract_counts/provider_token_counts/staged_followup_assembly_error_summary because empty row.get(..., {}) defaults counted as top-level mappings. The agenda appenders now use the shared direct-feedback learning-task sets and shared row+input_summary mapping/list accessors, so compact route-contract and target-prover replay feedback schedule repair agenda rows, generate next-action routing, and feed Formalizer proof-bank route memory without promoting proof evidence. Regression tests test_runtime_gap_planner_nested_contract_feedback_routes_repair_agenda and test_runtime_gap_planner_nested_target_prover_replay_feedback_routes_agenda cover agenda generation, generated routing, and proof-bank memory summaries for compact feedback rows.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.runtime_learning_rows_contract_input_sum: Eval/audit alignment gap found and patched: runtime, CLI, handoff selectors, and agenda appenders now support compact formal-gap feedback rows with learning_task and proof boundary fields under input_summary, but _runtime_learning_rows_contract_audit_summary still counted only top-level learning_task and top-level boundary fields. The audit/scorecard could therefore report a compact route-planner or target-prover feedback row as malformed even though AgentRuntime would consume it. The audit now reads learning_task and boundary values from row plus input_summary while still requiring routing and explicit non-proof evidence boundaries; scorecard remediation text now reflects the compact-row contract. Regression test test_runtime_learning_rows_contract_accepts_compact_formal_gap_feedback covers a compact live route-planner contract feedback row as valid repair memory, not proof evidence.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.coding_feedback_input_summary_loader_evi: Central coding-agent feedback-loop gap found and patched: runtime memory pinning and audit now accept compact rows with learning_task under input_summary, but the feedback loaders feeding AlgorithmEngineer and SimulationEngineer prompts still filtered algorithm_sandbox_execution_feedback, generated_simulation_sandbox_execution_feedback, coding_agent_generated_code_capability_feedback, and theory_trace_downstream_alignment_feedback using top-level learning_task only. Regression test test_coding_feedback_loaders_accept_compact_learning_task_rows covers compact algorithm sandbox feedback, integrated coding capability feedback for algorithm and simulation, and compact theory-trace alignment memory.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formalizer_feedback_input_summary_loader: Central formal-prover feedback-loop gap found and patched: after compact learning rows were accepted by memory/audit and replayed to AlgorithmEngineer/SimulationEngineer prompts, the Formalizer/ProofEngineer proof-bank memory loaders still filtered formalizer_lean_candidate_kernel_feedback, formalizer_lean_candidate_proof_state_feedback, formalizer_lean_candidate_component_gate_feedback, coding_agent_generated_code_capability_feedback, and formalizer_runtime_capability_contract_feedback using top-level learning_task only. The Formalizer loaders now read learning_task and prompt/contract fields from row plus input_summary while preserving non-proof boundaries. Regression test test_formalizer_feedback_loaders_accept_compact_learning_task_rows covers compact kernel diagnostics, ProofEngineer proof-state feedback, component-gate calibration, capability feedback, runtime contract feedback, prompt rendering, and runtime capability contract flags.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.source_theorem_repair_input_summary_load: Central source-theorem proof repair gap found and patched: _runtime_learning_memory_source_theorem_exact_candidate_repairs already consumed most repair fields from row plus input_summary, but its row classifier still used top-level learning_task for exact_source_theorem_proof_body_execution_feedback, source_theorem_proof_body_adapter_feedback, source_to_bridge_premise_derivation_feedback, source_theorem_formal_environment_repair_feedback, exact semantic-definition repair tasks, and generated_next_action_routing. Compact retained rows could therefore be accepted by memory/audit and still fail to route the next Formalizer/ProofEngineer prompt toward exact proof-body repair, source-to-bridge adapter derivation, or premise derivation. The repair-memory classifier now uses _runtime_learning_row_task(row,input_summary) for these task identities while preserving non-proof repair-memory boundaries. Regression test test_source_theorem_repair_memory_accepts_compact_learning_task_rows covers compact exact proof-body failure, proof-body adapter feedback, source-to-bridge premise feedback, proof-bank summary repair modes, and Formalizer prompt rendering.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.source_theorem_repair_input_summary_rete: Follow-up design gap found and patched: compact exact proof-body, source-theorem formal-environment, adapter, and source-to-bridge premise repair rows could now be read by source-theorem repair prompt loaders, but CLI/runtime-learning max_rows compaction still had a split policy surface that could drop compact source-theorem repair feedback behind later route-critical rows. CLI retention now mirrors the runtime context contract for these repair rows: explicit source-theorem repair priority, stable pin keys for exact proof-body artifacts, formal-environment placeholders, adapter unproven premises, and unverified premise feedback, plus route-critical pinning for Formalizer kernel/proof-state feedback with stable keys. Regression test test_runtime_learning_memory_loader_pins_compact_source_theorem_repair_rows covers bounded max_rows replay where compact source-theorem repair rows outrank later theory/architect/coding rows, while test_runtime_learning_memory_loader_retains_latest_diagnostic_helper now asserts Formalizer diagnostic helper retention is pinned kernel-feedback memory rather than accidental latest-row retention.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.runtime_learning_route_critical_shared_c: Follow-up design-drift guard added: after the compact source-theorem repair retention patch, CLI replay and runtime context still maintained separate literal route-critical learning-task/trigger sets and several pinned route-critical rows still had CLI-only row-index identity. research_agent_runtime.py now exposes RUNTIME_LEARNING_MEMORY_ROUTE_CRITICAL_LEARNING_TASKS/TRIGGERS as the shared contract, CLI imports those sets, Formalizer kernel/proof-state feedback receives explicit retention priority on both surfaces, Formalizer runtime capability-contract pin identity uses target_scope or question/global consistently, and CLI pin keys now match runtime context for theory-trace downstream alignment, architect orchestration, and runtime handoff-missing feedback. Regression test test_cli_and_runtime_route_critical_memory_pinning_stays_aligned compares CLI/runtime should-pin, priority, and pin-key behavior for representative compact/top-level route-critical rows and trigger-only rows.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.runtime_target_identity_audit_compact_ro: Eval/audit drift guard added: runtime and CLI route-critical memory retention now share RUNTIME_LEARNING_MEMORY_ROUTE_CRITICAL_LEARNING_TASKS/TRIGGERS, but target-identity audit still inferred route-critical rows from top-level text and target hints. Compact route-critical feedback rows with learning_task/target hints under input_summary could therefore be reusable pinned memory while escaping the scorecard's top-level target_ids completeness gate. research_agent_runtime_audit.py now imports the shared route-critical task/trigger sets, reads learning_task, trigger, and target hints from row plus input_summary, and reports compact nested learning_task/trigger values in missing-target diagnostics. Regression test test_runtime_target_identity_audit_uses_compact_route_critical_contract covers compact theory-trace downstream alignment feedback with a nested target_theorem_name, a global handoff row that should not require theorem target_ids, and the fixed top-level target_ids case.
latest_runtime_eval_alignment.formal_gap_planner_handoff_artifact_audi: Central eval/artifact-boundary gap found and patched: saved RuntimeFormalizationGapPlannerHandoff artifacts already carry standalone_seed_path, target_intake_path, LLM route-planner prompt/live CLI, reuse-smoke CLI, target_ids, and RUNTIME_FORMALIZATION_GAP_PLANNER_BRIDGE_NOT_PROOF_EVIDENCE, but the runtime capability audit only looked for nested formalization_gap_planner_execution_contexts on compact agenda/learning/pending rows. latest_runtime_eval_alignment.architect_research_path_control_propagat: Design-level control-plane gap found and patched: Architect evidence-contract policy/path existed, but Formalizer/ProofEngineer proposal packets, Lean candidate materialization, proof-state manifests, FormalizationGapPlanner bridges, standalone seeds, handoffs, execution manifests, and live route-planner manifests were not consistently stamped with runtime_architect_control.
